what: Findings 1 and 2 reproduced: after a binary buffer whose last line has no newline, a read of a newline-terminated file leaves the returned reference writing the new last line without its newline. The other rows are the neighbouring binary-state scripts, most of which the returned reference also gets wrong.
command: docker run --rm -v <returned>/solution/pyed:/app/pyed:ro -v <probe>:/probe:ro ed-verifier-v5 python3 /probe/diffrun.py <probes.json>: each script through /usr/bin/ed (GNU ed 1.19) and through the returned reference in fresh directories, LC_ALL=C, comparing stdout, zero exit status and the files left behind
